summary: Brookfield Wealth Solutions Ltd., a Bermuda-domiciled foreign private issuer, filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing its unaudited condensed consolidated interim financial statements and MD&A for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, along with Canadian-law CEO and CFO certifications. Total assets rose to $203.9 billion from $157.2 billion at year-end 2025, driven largely by growth in available-for-sale securities and future policy benefits. No transaction, stake, price or board recommendation is disclosed. This is an ordinary periodic reporting filing, not a special situation; no deal terms or risk-arb angle apply.
